description: A majestic fort in Jaipur known for its artistic blend of Rajput and Mughal architecture.
One of the largest forts in India located in Jodhpur with breathtaking views.
A living fort in the golden city built with yellow sandstone.
A royal palace showcasing a blend of Mughal and Rajasthani architecture.
A historic fort symbolizing Rajput bravery and sacrifice.
A scenic fort overlooking Jaipur famous for sunset views.
A beautiful marble temple with 1444 uniquely carved pillars.
A massive fort with the second longest wall in the world.
An unconquered and magnificent fort in Bikaner, known for its stunning red sandstone and marble architecture featuring intricate carvings, courtyards, and balconies.
A 17th-century fort in the Alwar district. Known as the most haunted fort in India, it offers stunning ruins, beautiful temples, and a thrilling historical experience.
Located in Bharatpur, this 18th-century structure is known as the 'Iron Fort'. It is famous for being one of the strongest ever built, having successfully withstood repeated attacks by the British.
Constructed in the 8th century, this impressive structure rests on a steep hillside in Ajmer. It features massive stone walls, the famous Bhim Burj, and incredible panoramic views of the city below.
